extra_brief:
This pipeline is part of China's Guangxi (广西) provincial gas grid. Non-standard rules for this scope:

- **Research primarily IN CHINESE.** Read `batches/china-guangxi-gas/staging/deepsweep-pilot/chinese_names.json` and pull YOUR ProjectID's entry: `zh_pipeline_name` / `zh_segment_name` / `zh_alt_names` are your PRIMARY search keys (the English name is a translation nobody in China uses). Combine them with terms like 天然气管道 / 输气管道 / 干线 / 支线 / 投产 / 开工 / 核准 / 竣工. Set `source_language: "zh"` on Chinese-sourced items.
- **Expect dead/unreachable sites; route around them.** Many Chinese sites are geo-blocked or bot-blocked from here — `fgw.gxzf.gov.cn` (Guangxi DRC) is KNOWN to time out. For an unreachable page, cite a `web.archive.org` snapshot instead (it must pass url_verifier like any URL) and record the original URL in researcher_notes. When one host fails, find the SAME information on an alternative working host — official announcements are widely republished (新华网, 人民网, sohu.com, sina, 澎湃新闻, and trade press 北极星 news.bjx.com.cn). BUT: republications of one original story = ONE source, not two, for the ≥2-independent rule.
- **Hosts confirmed reachable + verifier-clean from here (2026-07-29):** ndrc.gov.cn, pipechina.com.cn (国家管网), cnpc.com.cn, sinopec.com, news.bjx.com.cn, gx.chinanews.com.cn, gx.xinhuanet.com, wsbs.liuzhou.gov.cn, gdee.gd.gov.cn, sasac.gov.cn.
- **Known-blocked from here (pre-checked 2026-07-29, all ConnectTimeout):** `fgw.gxzf.gov.cn` (116 of this scope's existing ref links — over half the sheet's Guangxi sourcing), plus city DRC portals `fgw.liuzhou.gov.cn` / `fgw.nanning.gov.cn`, `gig.cn` (广西投资集团). Your unit's `existing_ref_checks` show per-URL results — a `ConnectTimeout` on these hosts means GEO-BLOCKED, not necessarily dead: go straight to a web.archive.org snapshot of that URL (verify the snapshot), don't waste time retrying the origin. A `200 but data value not found` check against an English word (e.g. `operating`) on a Chinese page is usually a FALSE miss — read the page yourself.
- **Ownership drift is likely:** PipeChina (国家管网集团) took over major trunk/provincial assets around 2020, and provincial grid companies (e.g. 广西天然气管道有限责任公司-type entities) restructure often — check whether the recorded Owner/Operator is still current before confirming it.
- **Status review, the timeliest question:** was this project (re)included in 15th Five-Year-Plan (十五五) energy plans or in Guangxi's annual key-project lists (广西壮族自治区重点建设项目 / 2026年重点项目)? 2025 closed the 14th FYP, so in-dev rows with no 15th-FYP presence are staleness candidates — treat plan inclusion as dated evidence like any other, absence as a signal to note, not proof.
